EA-008.note: Text and SpeechBalloon now share the native asynchronous Apply/Cancel dialog for creation and selected-object editing. Multiline text, family/size, bold/italic, horizontal alignment, independent alpha-preserving text color and balloon-tail controls commit once through EditorSession. Creation freezes pointer-down geometry/style/state/selection and the document generation; empty text or Cancel creates nothing. Tests cover full formatted creation, reload/history, frozen defaults, stale state/selection/replacement, disabled/dead owners, Escape/tool/source cancellation, duplicate Apply and deferred dialog teardown. Regressions reproduce and fix modal focus cancelling the draft and completed text-dialog destruction clearing a later modal operation. Existing optional fields retain legacy rendering and missing font names. Full text-border/fill breadth, saved preferences and physical visual/accessibility/target qualification remain partial. Creation rejects non-finite, negative or oversized font size/strength before session mutation using the existing reader/edit bounds. AnnotationShapesTest covers 35 invalid admissions, unchanged state/selection/source/history and retained redo, plus zero/fractional/maximum creation, reload and undo/redo for all seven affected types. Remaining options, resource cases and target/human qualification stay partial. Native Text/SpeechBalloon font-size controls now accept fractional values within the existing 1..2000 editing range. Unchanged Apply preserves the exact saved fraction or zero/default, including compatible values below the native minimum. Two native failures reproduced 0.125 becoming 1 before the fix. Tests cover both families, precision, Cancel/no-op, duplicate Apply, one history operation, undo/redo, reload and immutable source. Rendering and persistence ranges are unchanged. Native Text/SpeechBalloon creation and editing now offer an independent optional #AARRGGBB fill override, including fully transparent zero. Absence retains the exact legacy style/fallback rule; clearing restores it. UI/parse failures leave content/history intact; fill-only changes are one undoable mutation. Native creation, Apply/Cancel/no-op, canonical color, zero-alpha presence, undo/redo/reload, independent opaque/half/zero-alpha pixels and opaque unknown fields on other families are tested. Text-border and broader tool/native/physical qualification remain partial.

audit_scope: Linux candidate implementation and existing automated fixtures; supported-target and human acceptance remain separate.

audit.method: Read normative requirement text, inspect production call paths and automated test bodies/fixtures; graph navigation is not compliance evidence. Test surfaces listed here are context, not proof that each test covers every row. Implemented means tested Linux candidate behavior, never human/release or other-platform acceptance.
audit.remaining_scope: Text border/fill semantics, border/arrow/shadow and all-tool asset/transfer/affine breadth, ellipse/blur options and physical accessibility remain incomplete. Alphabetic/Roman/start/reset semantics await product answers.
audit.finding: Native tools reach all modes; text/balloon creation and editing use guarded asynchronous dialogs with family/style/alignment/text color/tail/fractional size. Numeric Step and fractional strength edits, create admission bounds, history/reload and ownership regressions are tested.

review_anchor.interpretation: EXTRACTED source/test anchors establish the described candidate seam only. They do not prove every requirement or remaining field; classifications follow the complete normative row.
